about: Golden set for #104 (docs/assembly.md). Each entry: a real LCSC part, JLCPCB's own (EasyEDA) footprint for it recorded in easyeda/<lcsc>.json, the KiCad library footprint it is paired with (kicad7.pretty), and the answer decided by hand, independently of ecadlib.assembly: 'correction' is the degrees JLCPCB's CPL needs added to the KiCad board angle (Assembly Rotation), 'pads' the expected pad verdict. 'how' says how the answer was decided. 'evidence': jlc-footprint (read off JLCPCB's footprint drawing: pin 1 / cathode mark / pin names, rendered with visual_check), jlc-preview (seen in JLCPCB's placement preview), community (published preview evidence).
